newsitem.title: UK: Commerical Union climbs on vague bid talk.
newsitem.headline: Commerical Union climbs on vague bid talk.

text.p: Shares in Commercial Union advanced on Monday as bid talk resurfaced following the group's results last week.
The shares were up 22p to 705p by 0926 GMT. Shares in General Accident also benefited from the interest in the sector to be up 9-1/2p at 845-1/2p.
"There was a very good market in the composites at the end of last week," said one trader. "They were all squeezed up and today there's a bit of bid talk, though no names have been mentioned."
Consolidation within the industry has been a theme recently amid speculation that companies may be looking for defensive mergers to offset difficult conditions in the non-life insurance market.
Guardian Royal was also up 3p at 280p.
"There's nothing specific," said another dealer. "It's just a re-hash of takeover stories."
General Accident is due to release its annual profits on Tuesday. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 4027
